verdict.rationale: The plugin marketplace docs say marketplaces provide version tracking and automatic updates. Skills can be packaged as versioned plugins with a version field in plugin.json, and the anthropics/skills repo can be registered as a marketplace. The API also accepts an optional skill version. Together these give a documented update path without reinstalling from scratch. Missing for 10: details on how auto-updates are triggered or configured, an explicit update command, and independent or hands-on confirmation that updates work.
